C0.note: Multiwinner approval voting with preference elicitation via queries.

C1.quote: Algorithm 2 finds a PJR+ committee with O(log(σk)) queries per voter
C1.note: Main results are query-complexity bounds for algorithms that output committees satisfying proportionality axioms.

C2.3.note: Voters hold approval intervals, which are elicited through queries.

C2.4.quote: asks voter v whether they approve candidate position x
C2.4.note: Query answers are taken to be the voter's approval set; there is no statement about truthful reporting.
